title: Whirlpool refrigerator ice maker not working — checks and likely causes

questions.ask: Do you have water dispensing normally from the door (if your model has a dispenser)? (yes/no)
Is the ice maker switch/arm turned ON and not stuck in the OFF position? (yes/no)
Is the freezer temperature around 0 degrees Farenheit to 5 F (-18 C to -15 C)? (yes/no/unsure)

checks: Confirm the ice maker is turned ON and the shutoff arm is down (not in the OFF position).
Verify freezer temperature is cold enough (ice production typically needs ~0°F to 5°F).
Check that the water supply line is turned on and not kinked.
Inspect/replace the water filter if it's overdue or flow is weak.
Look for a frozen fill tube (ice blockage preventing water from entering the ice maker).
If you hear no water fill and everything else checks out, the inlet valve may be failing.

likely_parts.reason: Example seeded part card reuse (replace with real fridge parts later)
